程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

类 InventoryView

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryView
public abstract class InventoryView extends Object
Represents a view linking two inventories and a single player (whose inventory may or may not be one of the two). 表示连接两个物品栏和单个玩家（其物品栏可能是二者之一，也可能不是）的视图。

Note: If you implement this interface but fail to satisfy the expected contracts of certain methods, there's no guarantee that the game will work as it should. 注意：如果你实现了此接口但未能满足某些方法的预期契约，则无法保证游戏会正常运行。

    • getType

      public abstract InventoryType getType()
      Determine the type of inventory involved in the transaction. This indicates the window style being shown. It will never return PLAYER, since that is common to all windows. 确定该次操作中涉及的物品栏类型。这指示了所显示的窗口样式。它永远不会返回 PLAYER，因为那是所有窗口共有的。
      返回:
      the inventory type 物品栏类型

    • setItem

      public void setItem(int slot, ItemStack item)
      Sets one item in this inventory view by its raw slot ID. 按原始槽位 ID 设置该物品栏视图中的一个物品。

      Note: If slot ID -999 is chosen, it may be expected that the item is dropped on the ground. This is not required behaviour, however. 注意：若选择槽位 ID -999，可能预期物品会被丢在地上。但这不是必需的行为。

      参数:
      slot - The ID as returned by InventoryClickEvent.getRawSlot() 由 InventoryClickEvent.getRawSlot() 返回的 ID
      item - The new item to put in the slot, or null to clear it. 要放入槽位的新物品，或为 null 以清除。

    • convertSlot

      public final int convertSlot(int rawSlot)
      Converts a raw slot ID into its local slot ID into whichever of the two inventories the slot points to. 将原始槽位 ID 转换为该槽位所指向的两个物品栏之一的本地槽位 ID。

      If the raw slot refers to the upper inventory, it will be returned unchanged and thus be suitable for getTopInventory().getItem(); if it refers to the lower inventory, the output will differ from the input and be suitable for getBottomInventory().getItem(). 若原始槽位指向上层物品栏，它将被原样返回，因此适用于 getTopInventory().getItem()；若它指向下层物品栏，输出将不同于输入，并适用于 getBottomInventory().getItem()。

      参数:
      rawSlot - The raw slot ID. 原始槽位 ID。
      返回:
      The converted slot ID. 转换后的槽位 ID。

    • close

      public final void close()
      Closes the inventory view. 关闭该物品栏视图。

    • countSlots

      public final int countSlots()
      Check the total number of slots in this view, combining the upper and lower inventories. 统计该视图的总槽位数，合并上层和下层物品栏。

      Note though that it's possible for this to be greater than the sum of the two inventories if for example some slots are not being used. 但注意，例如某些槽位未被使用时，该值可能大于两个物品栏之和。

      返回:
      The total size 总大小

    • getSlotType

      public InventoryType.SlotType getSlotType(int slot)
      Determine the type of the slot by its raw slot ID. 按原始槽位 ID 确定该槽位的类型。

      If the type of the slot is unknown, then InventoryType.SlotType.CONTAINER will be returned. 若槽位类型未知，则返回 InventoryType.SlotType.CONTAINER。

      参数:
      slot - The raw slot ID 原始槽位 ID
      返回:
      the slot type 槽位类型

      Sets an extra property of this inventory if supported by that inventory, for example the state of a progress bar. 若该物品栏支持，则设置它的一个额外属性，例如进度条的状态。
      参数:
      prop - the window property to update 要更新的窗口属性
      value - the new value for the window property 窗口属性的新值
      返回:
      true if the property was updated successfully, false if the property is not supported by that inventory 若属性更新成功则为 true；若该物品栏不支持此属性则为 false
